notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content: [list][*][p]The main work on the cutscenes in [i]Portal to Nowhere[/i] is nearly finished. What’s left is a final editing pass with the help of a friend to make sure all the text reads smoothly and is free of typos.[/p][/*][*][p]After that, I’m planning to run an [b]open playtest[/b], tentatively in [b]1-2 weeks[/b]. It’ll be a great chance to gather feedback, catch bugs, and see which scenes or puzzles work as intended - and which ones need a bit more polish.[/p][/*][*][p]I'm also thinking of adding some [b]sound effects[/b] - right now, the game is almost silent, and that definitely hurts the atmosphere. If I have time, I’ll try to add at least some basic audio before the playtest to bring things to life a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]Finally, I’ll be opening a [b]permanent Q&A thread[/b] in the Community Hub soon, where you’ll be able to ask anything about the development process.[/p][/*][/list]
